skills.name: Write a test
skills.teaches: Write the test first and watch it fail for the right reason. A test that has never failed proves nothing.

skills.name: Debug a failing test
skills.teaches: Read the failure before you change anything, and find the smallest change that makes it pass. Keep the test.

skills.name: Add a route
skills.teaches: Add the route, wire it into the app, and keep the handler thin. The handler reads the request and calls something else that does the work.

skills.name: Add an endpoint with validation
skills.teaches: Check the input at the edge and reject a bad request before any work starts. Everything below the validator can trust what it got.

skills.name: Write a migration
skills.teaches: Change the schema in a file that runs once and can be replayed on an empty database. Write the down step, and never edit a migration that has shipped.

skills.name: Verify a webhook signature
skills.teaches: Reject any request whose signature does not match, using the raw body and a constant-time compare.

skills.name: Honor an idempotency key
skills.teaches: Take a key from the caller, store the result under it, and return that same result when the key comes back. A retry must not charge twice.

skills.name: Retry with backoff
skills.teaches: Retry only the calls that are safe to repeat, wait longer after each attempt, and add jitter so every client does not come back at once. Stop at a bound and report the failure.

skills.name: Handle an error boundary
skills.teaches: Decide at the boundary which errors the caller sees and which only reach the log. Map each one to a status and a message that gives nothing away.

skills.name: Add a background job
skills.teaches: Move slow work off the request and make the job safe to run twice. The request records the work, the worker does it.
